lines.text: I keep seeing breaker vandalism and signs along the way...
Endmin, a tough battle may lie ahead. We'd best be ready.
Yeah. Tata just got a little better. We could really use a break.
The Origin Lodespring lies before us... It's quite close to the Æther Test Site, but this also means it might be severely affected by the Blight.
...Yes. We've arrived. The situation is quite complicated... I'll give you the details later.
Endmin? Director Qin and I were going over the situation in the areas near the Hub Base.
Neither the Landbreakers nor Aggeloi made any further moves as of yet... We can fully focus our efforts on this mission.
Awww. You're always the best, Tata!
Alright. Let's guard this place, just in case bad people show up!
Don't be scared! And I'll definitely take care of the fighting! Just stay behind me and be safe!
Me three! I'm totally ready to take on ten Aggeloi in a single battle!
What about you, Tata? Fully rested?
Alright, then. Let's move out, team!
